question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**slowest**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the slow progress of public schools in Fairfax, Virginia, towards reopening.
 
• The adjective that best fits the blank is "slowest," as it aligns with the context of the district lagging behind in reopening schools.
 
• Other options like "plainest," "longest," and "strangest" do not appropriately describe the speed or progress of reopening.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Plainest (सादा):** "Plainest" does not refer to progress or movement and is irrelevant in the context.
 
• **Longest (सबसे लंबा): **"Longest" refers to duration but does not fit the context of describing progress speed.
 
• **Strangest (सबसे अजीब):** "Strangest" is unrelated to describing progress and does not suit the sentence.
